name: Reaper Farm rfUSDT vault redeem without owner authorisation
summary: ReaperVaultV2 redeem(shares, receiver, owner) never verifies that the caller is owner or has the owner's share allowance, so the attacker burned a holder's rfUSDT shares and sent the underlying fUSDT to its receiver.
notes: Plain ReaperVaultV2 deployment; the 16,821-byte runtime is unchanged from creation through the exploit.

The sole attacker transaction emitted one Withdraw event for exactly 1,002.055460 fUSDT, valued at stablecoin par. A later third-party withdrawal sent the remaining assets to Reaper's rescue safe and is excluded.
